title: CHILD DEVELOPMENT CENTER INTERNSHIP
description: Participate in an internship in a research-based model early childhood program focused on early childhood education, program development and evaluation, parent education and administration.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: HDFS 330.
A minimum grade of C- is required in HDFS 330.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: MTWRF 8am-12:45pm in BATES 105 - Bates Hall (Fam. Study Ctr.) 105 (9/23 to 12/4)
